slides.title: FY27 Performance Snapshot
slides.body: Retail sales tracking ahead of plan through the first quarter. Trained 100 employees across 12 teams, with one proof-of-concept project per team and three winning solutions selected for production. The recommendation is to hold the current roadmap and release the second tranche of budget in November.

slides.title: What Could Move the Number
slides.body: Three items sit on the critical path. First, vendor capacity for the Advance workshop must be confirmed by 1 November. Second, the e-commerce channel mix shifted toward marketplace, which carries a higher commission and compresses margin. Third, two functions have not yet named their executive sponsor, which delays their proof-of-concept kickoff into the next quarter.

slides.title: Approve the Second Tranche
slides.body: The executive is asked to approve the second budget tranche and to confirm one sponsor per function. Approval this week keeps the Advance workshop on schedule and holds the savings captured in the vendor comparison.
